profile.proposedChange: Cache only those fixed compiled read/write patterns, following existing local OnceLock regex caches. Preserve pattern order, captures, alias/CTE binding and emitted edge order.
profile.limits: Do not attribute all remaining runtime to this snapshot, change graph semantics, or replace original outcomes. The sampled whole-repository follow-up includes profiling overhead; the 24 prior per-file timings remain untouched.
